# in reference assembly

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inReferenceAssembly`](gmeow-inReferenceAssembly.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inReferenceAssembly>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The reference assembly (e.g. GRCh38) in which these sequence coordinates are expressed. Functional: a coordinate tuple is expressed in exactly one assembly; coordinates in another assembly are a different [`SequenceCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md) instance ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
